name: Raman spectra of macular pigment carotenoids in human blood serum of glaucoma patients, ENIGMA trial, 18-month visit (Udensi, Loskutova, Loughman & Byrne 2024)
description: Whole-serum Raman spectra of 23 glaucoma patients of the ENIGMA trial at the 18-month visit (the deposit's 'whole serum18 months' folder; filename suffixes a-d are repeat measurements of the same patient within the visit). 100 measurement sessions (4 per patient, except ET043/ET048/ET049 with 6/8/6 -- the extra '_1' stems are re-taken exports of the same measurement). Horiba LabSpec6 dispersive Raman, native 2,541-point axes spanning 400.8-3,999.4 cm^-1 (~1.42 cm^-1 spacing); the loader interpolates every session onto the common 401-3,999 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,599 points), which all 246 valid session exports fully cover, so no extrapolation is involved. Multi-target regression: 11 targets per patient from the deposit's 18-month sheet -- macular-pigment optical density at 0.23/0.51/0.74/1.02 mm plus MP_Volume6.02_18M, visual acuity (VA_18M), microperimetry (Microperim_Aver_18M), OCT (mRNFL_6_18M, GCC_6calculate_18M, GCL_6_18M) and GAL9_18M. The sheet's Treatment column (trial arm 1/2, 15/8 patients) is a design factor, not an outcome, so it is not a target. group_ids = patient (23 groups): repeat measurements of one patient share the same target row, so grouped k-fold CV is leave-one-patient-out. Intensities are raw LabSpec counts as deposited (per file header DeNoise, Dark correction and ICS correction are all 'Off'); the excitation wavelength is not recorded in the deposit. Both datasets of the deposit share one frozen 9.5 MB Mendeley snapshot mirrored at HTW-KI-Werkstatt/RamanBench (glaucoma_enigma/snapshot/, size + sha256 pinned; the live Mendeley download sits behind a WAF that 403s non-browser clients, hence the mirror). Excluded: 19 sessions of subjects without 18-month targets (ET003, ET004, ET035, ET062 and the water_a/water_b reference scans) and ET0597_a (four-digit subject id, .l6s-only, presumably a mistyped duplicate of ET057/ET059, both already covered); the .l6s twins of the loaded sessions are not parsed, the .txt export is the canonical text form.

rai:dataCollection: ENIGMA clinical trial (glaucoma, macular pigment carotenoids in blood serum as a measure of ocular health). Whole-serum Raman spectra were recorded on a Horiba LabSpec6 dispersive Raman system; the excitation wavelength is not recorded in the deposit. 100 measurement sessions (4 per patient, except ET043/ET048/ET049) in the 18-month folder.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: None beyond interpolation onto the common 401-3,999 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,599 points). The .txt exports are raw LabSpec6 counts; the deposit applied no baseline correction or normalization.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Clinical target values (OCT, microperimetry, macular pigment optical density, visual acuity, GAL9) at 18 months measured by the trial's ophthalmic examinations and recorded in the deposit's 18-month sheet, one row per patient; every Raman session of a patient inherits that row. No human labelling of spectra was involved.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Spectra are derived from human blood serum of trial participants. Subject identifiers are pseudonymised (ET0xx); no direct patient identifiers are included, but the accompanying clinical values are health-related data under applicable data-protection regulations.
rai:dataBiases: All 23 patients are glaucoma cases of a single treatment trial; the treatment arm (15/8) is a per-patient design factor that varies within the cohort, not a class label. Sessions per patient are imbalanced (4, except ET043/ET048/ET049 with 6/8/6). Spectra of one patient are highly correlated (same blood, same visit), which is why group_ids = patient. Raw intensities are instrument counts; absolute levels are not comparable across acquisitions.
rai:dataLimitations: Single trial, single instrument, single visit: models are not validated against external instruments, cohorts, or a control group. 19 sessions (ET003, ET004, ET035, ET062 and the water_a/water_b reference scans) are present in the deposit but have no 18-month targets and were excluded, as was the .l6s-only ET0597_a (four-digit subject id, presumably a mistyped duplicate of ET057/ET059). The companion baseline visit is a separate dataset (glaucoma_enigma_baseline) from the same frozen snapshot.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports non-invasive monitoring research of glaucoma treatment response at 18 months from blood serum Raman spectra; any clinical use requires validation by qualified ophthalmic professionals.
rai:dataUseCases: Multi-target regression of 18-month ophthalmic endpoints from serum Raman spectra; leave-one-patient-out grouped k-fold CV (23 groups). Longitudinal pairing with glaucoma_enigma_baseline for treatment-response modelling.
